greeting.text: Hi, I'm Sarah. Thanks for joining. I'll ask you a few questions about your experience. Take your time with each answer.

q1.text: To start, tell me about yourself and the work you do day to day.

q2.text: Next, tell me about a project you're proud of and the part you played in it.

q3.text: Last question. Tell me about a time you had to learn something new quickly.

follow_up.text: Thanks. What was one decision in that work you made yourself?

finish_line.text: Let me just finish the question.

repeat_lead.text: Of course, here it is again.

time_limit.text: We've reached the time limit for this interview, so I'll stop here. Thank you.

closing.text: That's everything I wanted to ask. Thank you for your time today. The hiring team will review the interview and be in touch.
